name: To My Critics
simplified:
## Task
For each test case, decide whether any two of the three given digits have a sum greater than or equal to $10$.

## Details
- A pair consists of two different positions among the three digits.
- Output "`YES`" if such a pair exists, otherwise output "`NO`".
- The answer may be printed in any letter case.

## Input
- The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 1000$) — the number of test cases.  
- Each of the next $t$ lines contains three integers $a$, $b$, $c$ ($0 \le a, b, c \le 9$).

## Output
- For each test case, output a line with "`YES`" if there exists a pair of distinct digits whose sum is at least $10$, otherwise output "`NO`".
